file_stem: RWB E1 030 Daily rebalancing and queue measures
title: Daily rebalancing and queue measures
goal: A daily job assigns unowned cases, spreads over-cap load, and publishes reconciled queue measures
why: Workload stays fair without manual shuffling. Cases on deviation or legal hold never move, and measures publish only when they reconcile.
triggers: JOB-06 Daily rebalancing, 06:30 or after JOB-03
ace_note: No ACE read. Rebalancing works on Workbench cases, queues, members and timers.

writes.note: one entry per move, written first

stores: Outbox: CaseTransferred (EV-04) per move; data lake (JOB-15 copy); Power BI queue page
rules: BR2: an over-cap owner loses their newest cases (R-UNI-19)
BR3: deviation or legal-hold cases are never moved
BR6: measures publish only on zero difference (DL25, REC-01)
BR7: every move is logged first
risks: No member has capacity -> cases stay put (MSG-P3-011)
Snapshot does not reconcile -> not published (MSG-P3-029)
Decision log fails -> that case not moved, run continues (MSG-P7-003)
example: Queue TDR-BKK-CO (LOWEST_LOAD, cap 150) has 12 unowned cases
-> 8 cases to U-61, 4 to U-62, reason REBALANCE
